title: lens biebersteinii
intro: Lens biebersteinii, commonly known as Indian gentian or bitter gentian, is a flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lens biebersteinii include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve symptoms of indigestion and nausea, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, among others.
